# Check the count of each round in the dataframe
round_counts = df['round'].value_counts()

# Determine which rounds are listed exactly once
single_rounds = round_counts[round_counts == 1].index.tolist()

# The claim says: "only round 3 is not listed two times"
# This means round 3 should be the only round with count 1, and all other rounds should have count != 1
# Let's check if round 3 is in single_rounds and if there are no other single rounds
answer = (len(single_rounds) == 1) and (single_rounds[0] == 3)
